description: blueteam.brand's rules for fabric-pr arm. The repository has no code and no build: it is BlueTeam OÜ's brand source of authority, and the other repositories copy its machine-read files at a pinned commit. boundary.paths: the harness wiring (.claude/: settings and hooks; .mcp.json), CI and package manifests should the repository ever grow them (.github/, package.json and lockfiles, .npmrc), an environment file at any depth (.env*), a certificate or key file (*.pem), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, credential, token, key, auth). boundary.exempt is dropped first, but never under .claude/: Markdown, which is the brand guide, the claims and the decision records' prose, and .agent-fabric/. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary. No direct-to-main rule: every change is a pull request (the repository's README). Brand content (brand/tokens.css, and the font files directly in brand/assets/fonts/: .ttf, .otf, .woff, .woff2; any other file there stays in the boundary) is exempt since 2026-10-19: brand-comms arms it without a second word (boundary.changes).

changes.2026-10-19 content leaves the boundary: Content leaves the boundary so brand-comms arms it without a second word; the harness, CI, environment, ignore file, build configuration, manifests, deploy and secret files stay (devex-tooling's REQUEST 01a152a4-df8d-7c64-8f47-12992b3ca534; the owner chose narrowing in fabric-coordinator's session, 2026-10-19).
